europe_now.title: EU deficit rules drive firefighter cuts as wildfires intensify
europe_now.summary: European member states are reducing firefighter numbers due to EU fiscal constraints, even as wildfire risks increase across the continent. The EUobserver reports that deficit rules are forcing cuts to fire services despite the growing threat.

sources.headline: As Europe burns, member states are actually slashing the number of fire-fighters – thanks to EU deficit rules

europe_now.title: Europe accelerates Ukraine air defence support amid US shortfall
europe_now.summary: European nations are increasing military aid to Ukraine as the country's air defence systems, heavily reliant on US supplies, face critical shortages. France 24 reports that allies are gathering to address a €27 billion funding gap for Ukraine's air defence needs.

sources.headline: Europe ramps up support to Ukraine as its US-dependent air defence runs low

top_stories.title: Russian battlefield gains prompt European air defence scramble
top_stories.summary: Russian forces are penetrating deeper into Ukrainian territory, turning the front line into a vast grey zone according to a EUobserver battlefield update. European leaders are simultaneously rushing to compensate for dwindling US-supplied air defence interceptors.

sources.headline: Ukraine battlefield becoming one vast grey zone, as Russian units penetrating deeper (Ukraine Battlefield update, Day 1,642)
Europe ramps up support to Ukraine as its US-dependent air defence runs low

top_stories.title: EU fiscal rules blamed for firefighter reductions during wildfire season
top_stories.summary: An EUobserver investigation finds that member states are cutting firefighter positions to comply with EU deficit limits, even as climate change drives more severe wildfires. The report highlights a contradiction between EU climate goals and budgetary enforcement.

sources.headline: As Europe burns, member states are actually slashing the number of fire-fighters – thanks to EU deficit rules

top_stories.title: Volkswagen warns of existential crisis for German automotive sector
top_stories.summary: Volkswagen has issued a stark warning that Germany's car-making industry faces jeopardy due to high costs, weak demand, and the transition to electric vehicles. The company's statement underscores structural challenges for Europe's largest industrial sector.

sources.headline: Volkswagen warns Germany's car-making industry is in jeopardy

top_stories.title: France and Saudi Arabia expand strategic partnership across multiple domains
top_stories.summary: French and Saudi officials held wide-ranging talks in Paris covering defence, energy, and cultural cooperation including esports. Both sides emphasized mutual economic dependence and a shared interest in regional stability.
